run_confirm.assign_batch: Assign {{count}} issues to {{name}}. They'll start right away if the run conditions are met.

create_squad.title: Create Squad
create_squad.description: Create a collaborative squad with a leader agent and optional additional members.
create_squad.description_placeholder: Describe what this squad is responsible for...
create_squad.leader_hint: The leader receives all tasks assigned to this squad and coordinates the team.
create_squad.members_hint: Members the leader can delegate sub-tasks to. Can be added later.
create_squad.no_agents: No active agents available. Create an agent first.
create_squad.identity_heading: Who are you in this squad?
create_squad.identity_hint: This is what the room sees next to your name, and it decides whose work lands on you by default. It is written to your account, so every room from here on already knows it.
create_squad.identity_registered: Registered as {{identity}}. Picking another changes your account's identity, not just this squad's.
create_squad.identity_unregistered: You have not declared one yet — onboarding was skipped. Pick one here and it is saved to your account.
create_squad.people_heading: Who else is in this room?
create_squad.people_hint: Add people and agents now, or leave it empty and add them from the room later.
create_squad.roles_heading: What does each of them do?
create_squad.roles_hint: Role is what someone decides in the room. The switch is whether work may run on their agents — independent, because an observer can lend an agent and an executor can switch theirs off while away.
create_squad.room_hint: This is the name the squad answers to, in the rail and in @mentions.
create_squad.room_summary_one: {{count}} person in the room. You join as {{identity}}.
create_squad.room_summary_other: {{count}} people in the room. You join as {{identity}}.
create_squad.agents_come_with_owner: Agents are not invited here. Each person brings their own, bound on their own account — you decide below whose may take work.
create_squad.leader_needs_agent: Leads the room but has no agent — the squad needs one to route its work to.
create_squad.leads_with_agent: The squad's work routes to this one

create_project.local_pick_failed: Could not open the directory picker.
create_project.local_invalid_dir: This directory can't be used. Pick another.
create_project.local_hint: Agents on other machines won't see this path — they'll fail to start. Use repos for shared work.
